label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass; never at D1 or D2). 98% of mass is on GO steps where the previous trial was not rewarded (prev_reward 0, or a -1 penalty after a D1 fixation break, where rate is about 50%). It basically never fires after a rewarded trial. It also grows strongly with episode time: none in trials 0-9, about 3% of mass before trial 50, and 69% in trials 80-99. Rate goes up as the value-head output goes down (40% of mass in the lowest value bin, none above 8.1). Top windows are runs of consecutive unrewarded trials where activation builds across trials, often around a switch (stay == 0 has 4x lift). There is a mild bias toward prev_action a1. Precision is low (about 0.22): most late-episode GO steps after no reward stay silent, and I found no observed variable that separates them (consecutive losses, low value, stay/switch and previous action each traded recall for little precision; best F1 about 0.35). So this reads as a weak unrewarded-at-GO signal whose gain depends on episode time and low value, and it probably carries information in its magnitude. All predicate variables are observed or are clock time; none are FUTURE.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, ?) and trial before (GO: a1 S1 u, a2 S2 u, a1 S2 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=9, phase=GO & ep_dec=8, phase=GO & ep_dec=7.
